title: USC standard rates and thresholds
text:
Universal Social Charge (USC) is payable on gross income, including notional pay, before any pension contributions are deducted.

For 2025, the standard rates of USC are:

Income up to EUR 12,012 is charged at 0.5%.
Income from EUR 12,012.01 to EUR 27,382 is charged at 2%.
Income from EUR 27,382.01 to EUR 70,044 is charged at 3%.
Income above EUR 70,044 is charged at 8%.

If your total income for the year does not exceed EUR 13,000, you are exempt from USC.

Self-employed individuals with non-PAYE income exceeding EUR 100,000 pay an additional 3% surcharge on the portion of income above EUR 100,000.

These figures are illustrative sample data used for development and testing of this application. Always confirm current rates on revenue.ie.
